en.headline: Hong Kong boccia pair win gold on Asian Para Games final day
en.dek: Leung Yuk-wing and Cheung Yuen beat China 9-0 in the mixed BC4 doubles, while the team also took two bronzes.
body: Hong Kong boccia athletes Leung Yuk-wing and Cheung Yuen won gold in the mixed BC4 doubles at the Asian Para Games on Saturday, defeating the Chinese pair 9-0.

The victory gave the Hong Kong delegation its third gold of the Games. On the same final competition day, the boccia team also secured two bronze medals: Chan Pak-lun, Lung Tsz-kin and Yeung Hiu-lam in the mixed BC1/BC2 team event, and Tse Tak-wa and Chan Ho-yan in the mixed BC3 doubles.
The Hong Kong Paralympic Committee said the results completed a strong close for the boccia squad. Medal winners are eligible for cash awards under the Jockey Club Outstanding Athletes Award Scheme.
The Asian Para Games close later on Saturday, with para fencer Tong Nga-ting serving as flagbearer for the Hong Kong team.

zh.headline: 亞殘運硬地滾球 梁育榮張沅9比0勝中國組合奪金
zh.dek: 港隊在最後比賽日再添一金兩銅，硬地滾球項目表現突出。
body: 香港硬地滾球運動員梁育榮及張沅在亞洲殘疾人運動會混合BC4級雙人賽以9比0擊敗中國組合，奪得金牌。
這是香港代表團今屆第三面金牌。同日，硬地滾球隊另奪兩面銅牌：陳柏麟、龍子健及楊曉林在混合BC1/BC2級團體賽，以及謝德樺、陳可欣在混合BC3級雙人賽。
中國香港殘疾人奧委會表示，硬地滾球隊在最後比賽日再有收穫。得牌運動員可獲賽馬會優秀運動員獎勵計劃獎金。
亞殘運於周六閉幕，輪椅劍擊運動員湯雅婷擔任中國香港代表團閉幕禮持旗手。
